title: Si: phonon-assisted absorption, emissivity, carrier mobility and ARPES
summary: Electron-phonon system folder of silicon: PAOFLOW builds the coarse coupling from the ph.x dvscf files (no EPW) and interpolates it in the PAO basis: phonon-assisted (indirect) absorption and the thermal emissivity of a wafer, phonon-limited electron and hole mobilities, Fan-Migdal linewidths with the ARPES band maps, the phonon dispersion and the dynamical quadrupoles.

steps.label: Quantum ESPRESSO: scf, ph.x, nscf, optics nscf
steps.note: qe/phonon: scf and ph.x on the 3^3 q-grid (fildvscf, epsil); qe/nscf: the 6^3 nscf; qe/optics: the 60-band nscf of the extended basis. Each nscf starts from a copy of the scf charge density (run_qe.sh does it); NP ranks, 8 by default
